premises.text: Most web publishers lack tools to recognize and reward user attention and loyalty the way offline loyalty programs do
premises.evidence_span: publishers don't really have the tools to do so

premises.text: Badgeville is a flexible loyalty and rewards platform using game mechanics—status, reputation, achievements, leaderboards—tied to publisher-defined behaviors
premises.evidence_span: We're a loyalty and rewards platform for web publishers to drive engagement

premises.text: Platform plugs into existing registration, supplies embed codes/widgets/API, and admin tools so marketers can define behaviors and rewards quickly
premises.evidence_span: We've made it really easy for marketers, community managers to implement this very quickly

premises.text: Analytics show valued behaviors, top users, community health, and friction points for publishers
premises.evidence_span: These are the kinds of analytics we can provide to our clients

value.text: Maximize engagement for web publishers by rewarding valued user behaviors

causal_links.evidence_span: online, it's very difficult for us to get recognized and rewarded for our attention and our loyalty
